doc: Warped variable Voronoi cells over a FIXED open-cell size field (the input, 64x64); the Poisson draws and the warp fBm vary with the seed. STATISTICAL: 30 seeds (1000..1029), 3 metrics (names and definitions in params). The port draws its own random numbers, so it cannot reproduce `values`; it computes each metric exactly as defined, for its own seeds, and checks |metric - mean| <= n_sigma * std per metric for one seed (n_sigma * std / sqrt(m) for the mean of m seeds). mean and std (ddof = 1) are what the Python code produces; the recomputation check holds them at 1e-9 (no flipped texel in the nudge experiments).

definitions: fraction of texels with border < 0.05 (the walls)
